Definition: perhaps for G2496; Jorim, an Israelite:--Jorim.
BiblicalUsage: Jorim is one name in Luke's genealogy, standing between Eliezer and Matthat. In Luke 3:29 he is named in the line that runs from Jesus back to Adam, a link between two men the world has forgotten.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jorim's name is there for the same reason every link is there: the promise did not skip a generation, and God kept count of them all.
